meta.title: PPT汇报：怎么长时间抓住听众注意力
meta.title_en: How to Hold Your Audience's Attention in a PPT

scenes.title_cn: 难题开场：听众记不住你的页
scenes.context: 讲者指出做 PPT 最难的是长时间抓住听众注意力，并用「贫穷的三个原因」这一页 PPT 演示：讲完翻页，内容立刻被忘记。
sentences: 做PPT一定会遇到一个超级大难题：很难长时间抓住听众的注意力。
When you present with a PPT, you'll hit a huge problem: it's hard to hold your audience's attention for long.
抓听众注意力：hold your audience's attention
比如你的一页PPT上，标题是贫穷的三个原因，下面写了三点。
Say your slide says, Three Causes of Poverty, with three bullet points below.
一页PPT：a slide
讲完这一页翻过去，内容会立刻被忘记——我刚才讲了39个字，你能回忆得出来吗？
The moment you flip past the slide, it's instantly forgotten. I just said 39 words — can you recall them?
立刻被忘记：instantly forgotten
paraphrase: 讲PPT难在听众记不住 → 内容需要主动加工
The hard part isn't content — it's memory. Make them process it.
被动听讲 → 主动回忆
From passive listening to active recall.
scenes.speak: When you present with a PPT, you'll hit a huge problem: it's hard to hold your audience's attention for long. Say your slide says, Three Causes of Poverty, with three bullet points below. The moment you flip past the slide, it's instantly forgotten. I just said 39 words — can you recall them?

scenes.title_en: Two questions: rank it, justify it
scenes.context: 讲者给出解法：讲完别翻页，先问「按权重怎么排序」，再问「为什么这么排」，然后停顿，让听众自己权衡。
sentences: 讲完这一页，不要翻过去，而是问两个问题。
Don't flip the slide when you finish — ask two questions instead.
不要翻过去：don't flip the slide
第一个问题：这三个原因按权重从高到低，你会怎么排？
First question: how would you rank these three causes, from the most to the least important?
按权重从高到低：rank from most to least important
第二个问题：为什么？你的理由是什么？然后停顿，台下的人全部会乖乖闭嘴。
Second question: why? What's your reasoning? Then pause — everyone in the room will shut up and think.
乖乖闭嘴：shut up and think
paraphrase: 给问题而非答案 → 让听众自己思考
Give questions, not answers — let them think it through.
提问后停顿 → 把话语权交给听众
Pause after asking — hand the floor back to the room.
scenes.speak: Don't flip the slide when you finish — ask two questions instead. First question: how would you rank these three causes, from the most to the least important? Second question: why? What's your reasoning? Then pause — everyone in the room will shut up and think.

scenes.title_en: The trick: there is no right answer
scenes.context: 讲者揭示排序问题没有标准答案，123/321/231都OK，目的是让听众为了比较必须想明白这三点是什么；反复问为什么，挑逗听众吵架，自己在旁边看戏。
sentences: 正确答案是没有正确答案，123、321、231都OK。
The right answer is that there is no right answer — any order works.
没有正确答案：there is no right answer
你要的并不是排序的结果，而是为了做出比较，听众必须想明白这三点是什么。
You don't want the ranking itself — you want them to understand the three causes so they can compare.
做出比较：make the comparison
你只要不停重复为什么、怎么排，甚至挑逗群众，然后就在边上吃瓜看戏。
Just keep asking why and how they'd rank it, even tease them — then sit back and enjoy the show.
吃瓜看戏：sit back and enjoy the show
paraphrase: 排序是手段 → 想明白是目的
Ranking is a means; understanding is the goal.
讲得多 → 问得多、省口水
scenes.speak: The right answer is that there is no right answer — any order works. You don't want the ranking itself — you want them to understand the three causes so they can compare. Just keep asking why and how they'd rank it, even tease them — then sit back and enjoy the show.

practice: It's hard to hold your audience's attention.
How would you rank these, from most to least important?
There's no right answer — any order works.
I'll just sit back and enjoy the show.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Hold the audience's attention for a long time.
✓ 地道说法：It's hard to keep people engaged.
keep engaged 比 for a long time 更口语。
✕ 直译腔：The content will be forgotten immediately.
✓ 地道说法：People forget it the moment you flip the slide.
the moment 时间感更强，更自然。
✕ 直译腔：Please rank from high to low by weight.
✓ 地道说法：Which one matters most? Rank them.
matters most 替代 by weight 更口语。
✕ 直译腔：I'm eating melons and watching a show.
✓ 地道说法：I'll just sit back and enjoy the show.
sit back and watch 是地道口语。
shifts: 把 PPT 讲完就算完成任务
让听众为内容做一次思考才算完成
靠讲得多、讲得密抓注意力
靠提问与停顿让听众自己加工
每个提问都要有标准答案
没有标准答案的提问反而更有用
